name: RankJet AI-Powered SEO & Ranking Growth
author: wpdive

sections.description:
RankJet AI is a powerful platform for SEO optimization. This plugin connects your WordPress site to your RankJet account, enabling:

  • Cloud Integration: Automatically sync your content with RankJet.
  • AI-Powered SEO: Generate meta titles, descriptions, and keywords directly from the platform.
  • Content Analysis: Get real-time scoring and suggestions.
  • Centralized Management: Manage SEO for multiple sites from one dashboard.

Note: A RankJet AI account is required to use this plugin.

Features

✅ AI-Powered Analysis
* User experience focused
* Content Optimization
* Keyword Research
* Competitor Analysis
* SERP Tracking
* AI Content Generation
* Bulk SEO Editing
* Automated Meta Tags
* Schema Markup
* Content Scoring
* SEO Recommendations
* Rank Tracking
* SERP Analysis
* Content Optimization
* Keyword Research
* Competitor Analysis
* SERP Tracking
* AI Content Generation
* Bulk SEO Editing
* Automated Meta Tags
* Schema Markup
* Content Scoring
* SEO Recommendations
* Rank Tracking
* SERP Analysis

How It Works

1. Connect Your Site
* Install the plugin and enter your RankJet API token.
* Authorize the connection between WordPress and RankJet AI.
2. Content Sync
* Automatically sync your posts and pages to the RankJet platform.
* Manage your content from a centralized dashboard.
3. AI Optimization
* Get AI-powered suggestions for titles, descriptions, and keywords.
* Improve your content with data-driven recommendations.
4. Track Your Rankings
* Monitor your keyword rankings and SERP positions.
* Analyze competitor performance and identify opportunities.

Free Tools

✅ SERP preview simulator
✅ Content Analyzer
✅ Blog Post Ideas

Want full features? Get started with RankJet AI

External Services

This plugin connects to the RankJet AI Platform to synchronize content and retrieve SEO data.

  • Service: RankJet AI
  • Data Sent: Post content, titles, and existing SEO meta data.
  • Purpose: To analyze content and generate SEO suggestions using RankJet’s AI models.
  • Terms of Service: https://rankjet.ai/terms-of-service/
  • Privacy Policy: https://rankjet.ai/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload rankjet-ai.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to RankJet.ai > Integration in your WordPress admin.
  4. Enter your RankJet API Token to connect your site.
